description: This source file defines various custom attributes used in the Orleans framework to specify grain behaviors such as request handling, concurrency, and placement strategies. It includes attributes like ReadOnly, Reentrant, Unordered, StatelessWorker, AlwaysInterleave, MayInterleave, and OneWay, which are used to annotate grain classes and methods to influence runtime behavior and optimizations.

classes.name: ReadOnlyAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark methods that do not modify the state of a grain, enabling runtime optimizations.

classes.name: ReentrantAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark grain classes that allow request interleaving within a task, enabling certain runtime optimizations.

classes.name: UnorderedAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark grain interfaces where message delivery order is not significant.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark grain classes that do not preserve state between requests and allow multiple activations.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark methods that can interleave with any other method, including non ReadOnly requests.

classes.name: MayInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark classes that control request interleaving via a callback method.

classes.name: OneWayAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark methods as one-way, indicating no response will be sent.
